kicker: NOT BROKE. JUST DONE WITH IMPULSE BUYS
title: Only *12 things* all year

label: THE PROBLEM
head: Most of what you "need" is a bored Tuesday night
sub: $40 here, $60 there, all from a shopping app at 11PM.

label: RULE 1
head: Want it? Add it to a list, not the cart
sub: Adding it to the list gives the same hit without the regret.

label: RULE 2
head: Move $60 a week into a fun money account
sub: One item a month, only if the account covers it.

label: RULE 3
head: Wait 30 days, then reread the list
sub: Half gets deleted. The urge was a mood.

text: You stop reacting to impulses and *decide what earns your money.*

head: Start the *list* tonight
sub: Groceries, rent and bills don't count.
